text:
lisa_nguyen: Heads-up — vendor (NordAir) proposed splitting H100 allocation: 6 units air (expedite) + 14 sea. They want to mark 6 as 'partial RMA replacement' to avoid customs delays. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

raj_shah: Why split? lead time for full air would be ~7 days and +$2k per unit. Sea is ~28 days. If we accept split, need to confirm AWB + invoice HS code. Also check insurance coverage for split AWBs.

oliver_ops: We can take the 6 air at EU depot but depot requires pre-approval of serials + photos before arrival. Can carrier pre-stage manifest and send to depot?

warehouse_depot_eu: Marta: Yes, we need `manifest.csv` with serial, model, ETA, AWB. Accept photos for DOA only. If vendor marks as RMA, we need RMA# and return instructions. DM me sample manifest.

lisa_nguyen: Vendor sent this today — AWB GBX123456789, declared value $120k total for 6 units. They propose HS code 8471.80 (computing machinery). Carrier flagged customs risk if mis-declared. Also they want our PO number on AWB.

raj_shah: HS 8471.80 is OK but customs sometimes treat GPUs as `parts` not `complete machines`. Ask vendor to attach commercial invoice with line-level descriptions. I'll ping customs broker.

carrier_bot: Tracking update: GBX123456789 — Accepted at origin; ETA FRA 2026-04-12 09:00 UTC. Status: Awaiting export docs.

supply_ops_mgr: Quick budget check — expedite fee for 6 air units = $12k total. If we accept air+sea split, can we reallocate budget from Dedicated reserve? @finance please confirm.

finance_jules: Jules: We have ~€8k in expedite bucket; need additional approval for remainder. Please attach vendor invoice and expedite justification.

oliver_ops: Ops note — if vendor uses 'partial RMA' flow, we must ensure depot doesn't attempt to re-assign units to other clusters. Add `hold-for-customer` on manifest.

lisa_nguyen: Vendor also asked to destroy original outbound packaging on delivery to reduce freight weight — depot doesn't allow destroyed packaging for warranty claims. Marta, can depot accept 'no original box' for incoming RMA?

warehouse_depot_eu: Marta: No — we need original packaging for warranty logging. If vendor won't ship boxes, we can still accept but warranty claim transfer may be denied. Need signoff from Legal.

raj_shah: Suggestion: push vendor to include loaner replacements instead of marking as RMA to avoid paperwork. But that increases unit cost. Also confirm serial transfer and warranty chain of custody.

lisa_nguyen: I've asked vendor for two options: 1) Full air for 6 with original packaging and warranty transfer (costly) 2) Air as loaners + sea for permanent replacements (cheaper). Waiting on reply.

vendor_rep_amanda: Amanda (vendor): Confirmed — we can do option 2 but loaners require deposit and a 30-day return SLA. Deposit = $20k total. Photos pre-shipment provided. Can we sign MSA amendment?

supply_ops_mgr: Deposit ok but need legal to sign MSA amendment. @legal-sme can you review? Timeline: need decision within 48h to hit origin cutoff.

legal_sme: Legal: We'll need the loaner addendum and clarify liability during transit, and the insurance beneficiary. Share vendor contract PDF.

carrier_bot: Note: Air AWB updated — GBX123456789 changed consignor to 'NordAir Logistics' and weight updated +12kg. ETA unchanged.

lisa_nguyen: Also, customs broker says if vendor claims 'RMA' and marks value $0, EU import may detain. We need commercial invoice with realistic values or RMA docs signed by our customs broker.

raj_shah: I'll coordinate with broker. Action items: vendor to send manifest + photos, vendor to confirm packaging, legal to review addendum, finance to confirm expedite budget, depot to prep hold tags. Assigning owners in sheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1EXAMPLE (see tab 'air-split-510').

warehouse_depot_eu: Marta: Once we have manifest, please send to depot inbox: eu-depot-alloc@redwood.com. We'll pre-stage pallet location and assign quarantine tags.

lisa_nguyen: Thanks — pinging vendor for manifest now. I'll update thread once we have docs. :pray:
